routing_warnings.description: The freelancer reports recording three alternative raw takes but does not establish that they were packaged as separate MP3 files.
The freelancer reports producing five additional takes; the source does not specify separate-file or MP3 packaging.
The freelancer accepts the editing and delivery request but does not claim that the selected files were edited or delivered.
The request for more energy and liveliness changes the performance-tone Requirement, although the same message also requests another alternative take.
The request to reduce pauses and make the last sentence smoother concerns voice-over pacing rather than production of alternative takes.
The request to edit the two selected takes is independently actionable under the selected-take editing Requirement.
The report of recording three raw takes supports delivery of alternative takes but does not specifically claim that the pacing requirement was implemented.
The message confirms managerial approval of one of the final two takes but does not explicitly verify that both selected takes were edited.
